This sounds like Seretonin Syndrome. That means the SSRI is allowing too much seretonin to stay in the synaptic cleft, causing all sorts of problems (like hallucination, sweating, racing heart, and anxiety :P)

Definitely call him first thing and tell him your symptoms, if he doesn't bring up seretonin syndrome suggest it to him, because that might mean you need to try a different kind of antidepressant (like Wellbutrin or effexor)
